Plugin.Name: Timetable
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: schedule scheduler cron calendar timeline overlap mover parity trim user scripts backup
Plugin.Overview:
Everything scheduled on your server in one place: the parity check, the mover, TRIM, User Scripts, Appdata Backup, auto updates and every other line in the crontab, on a timeline of the next 7 days and in a list with the file each job comes from.
It warns when jobs overlap where it matters, for example the mover running during a parity check, or a backup stopping containers while the mover works, and says why each one matters.
- Run lengths come from the server's own history where there is one. - Each job links to the page where it is set up.
It only reads. It never changes a setting or runs a job.
